Exact 2027 dates are not yet published by any school; treat 'early October to early December 2027' as the planning window and confirm with the school in mid-2027. | NON-EU: No UPC rule excludes non-EU applicants from the February entry. UPC preinscripcio page: 'Amb el document d'admissio, l'estudiant de fora de la UE pot iniciar els tramits de sol.licitud dels visats que els permetin l'estada al nostre pais per cursar el programa de master universitari.' Programme fitxes state only 'Legalisation of foreign documents: All documents issued in non-EU countries must be legalised and bear the corresponding apostille.' MASTEAM adds: 'You can enrol even if the legalization procedures have not finished, but you should demonstrate that you have at least started the legalization procedures.' MASTEAM's own calendar warns: 'Non-European Union nationals should apply as soon as possible, in order to obtain admission soon enough to proceed with the visa request at the Spanish consulates in their countries.' The February window is therefore legally open but operationally very tight, and is the single most likely point of failure. | FEES: Non-EU non-resident price CONFIRMED at 45,00 EUR/credit for first-time credits (UPC 'Preus i beques', 2026-27: row 'Master universitari habilitant i no habilitant (no residents, no UE)' = 45 EUR, 1a matricula; EU non-qualifying master = 19,37 EUR/credit, matching Decret 96/2026). Cross-checked arithmetically against each programme fitxa: 120 ECTS -> 5.400 EUR (=120x45); 90 ECTS -> 4.050 EUR (=90x45); 60 ECTS -> 2.700 EUR (=60x45). CONFLICT: UPC's own master's FAQ (both CA and EN) states 'Per-credit fees for non-resident foreign students who are non-European Union students (non-EU residents) are EUR102.52 for the NON-qualifying master's degree' -- this figure is irreconcilable with UPC's own fee table and per-programme totals and is treated as stale. Nothing on the fee pages differentiates a February entrant: the price is per credit per matricula, and UPC bills semester-by-semester ('segons el tipus de matricula (anual o quadrimestral)'), so a QP entrant pays the same per-credit rate.
